REDESIGN it radically to fit just THIRTY-NINE logical square cells in width and height. This is an extremely coarse old NES / early handheld RPG menu icon, not a detailed pixel illustration.

PIXEL BUDGET: the ENTIRE head including hair is about 23 cells wide. The FACE is only 12 cells wide and 13 cells high. The nose is ONE pixel. No fine texture, no shading inside pixel tiles, no tiny staircase steps, no smooth gradients anywhere. All edges take steps of one enormous square tile. Bold hand-designed connected clusters and beautiful economical pixel shorthand. Sacrifice tiny decoration to preserve the silhouette and facial expression. It must be dramatically coarser than a normal 80x80 sprite. DO NOT reproduce detailed illustration covered with small mosaic blocks.

Keep the close bust framing and right-facing angle of the source. The dark brown border and muted gold FRAME 1 are simplified to a ONE-CELL-wide square gold line with tiny 2x2 corner ornaments, pale ivory flat background. One standalone square sprite.
